_doc: The controls as a new player meets them, in the motion studio: the hint strip at the start, the strip after the player has moved and rolled, and the pause page's 'How to move and fight'. xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1280x720x24' godot --path game --rendering-driver vulkan --rendering-method forward_plus --audio-driver Dummy --resolution 1280x720 --fixed-fps 60 res://tools_gd/motion_studio.tscn -- --plan=tools/capture/plans/controls.json --out=captures/controls
